node.title: set context for method's return values
node.author: demoralizer
node.doctext:
Hi folks,

I wonder if it is possible to use a method's return value as an array without pre-storing it into one.
This is what I really want to do: print(split(",", "A,B,C,D")[2]);
Only solution I found (without storing the values into an array), was: print([split(",", "A,B,C,D")]->[2]);
Is there a common perl-ish way how one can "set" the context for method's return values?

Thanks a lot in advance for all your wisdom!
